{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
new_customers_paid_search = sales_df[
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Compute the number of new customers reached by paid search
num_new_customers_paid_search = len(new_customers_paid_search)

# Compute the number who converted
num_converted = new_customers_paid_search['converted'].sum()

# Compute the fraction who converted
fraction_converted = num_converted / num_new_customers_paid_search

# Print all required numbers
print("Number of new customers reached by paid search:", num_new_customers_paid_search)
print("Number who converted:", num_converted)
print("Fraction who converted:", fraction_converted)"}
